caption: The drawing shows a figure with a light beige face and hands, cloaked in a brown robe that extends in wide, triangular shapes to the bottom corners of the composition. The figure has a serene, oval face with simple facial features and is framed by a golden yellow halo made up of radiating lines. The figure holds a cloth in front of its chest, which depicts a face with a crown of thorns, rendered in black, brown, and beige. The background within a rectangular border is filled with wavy and vertical lines in shades of pink, light brown, blue, and gray, with the border itself outlined in red. The lower left corner of the drawing contains the number "20."
title: Plate 20: Saint Veronica: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
